scope: Selected existing native dialog/picker, status visibility, column autocomplete and cell-checkbox projection. No new dialog, control, input UI, Office FileDialog/settings object or remote provider is added. Headless and missing services fail explicitly; this is not all Excel interactions or complete reference compatibility.

required_obligations.profile: Seven existing command dialogs: Column Width 47, Row Height 127, Zoom 256, Insert Cells 55, Delete Cells 54, Define Name 61, Hyperlink 596. Item uses Excel IDs, Count/enumeration cover only these native entries; global object identity is shared. Show supports omitted Arg1..Arg30 only; presets refuse. Show suspends, releases borrows and returns actual OK=True or Cancel=False. Failed commands keep the dialog open. Dialog borrows no engine document; owner document/window/sheet/selection/range epoch and consent are checked before commands. UI and control entry points share the guard. Reset/close remove the owned modal and stale token; editor visibility is restored.

Native existing pick_open/pick_save callbacks only. Default workbook filters/title/buttons; GetOpenFilename supports omitted/False MultiSelect. GetSaveAsFilename accepts InitialFilename (otherwise native workbook title). Unsupported presets refuse before a callback. Filename queries return a bounded path or Boolean False on Cancel and do not open/save. FindFile additionally opens through the existing loader only after a successful native pick; no browser path-based open is claimed. Requests are delivered once, duplicate/late responses refuse, and reset/consent revocation cancel without replay.

Get/Let use the actual native UiState.status_bar field and existing status-bar renderer through an owned host operation and the UI command view.statusBarVisible. No fake headless global or custom status text is stored.

Single-cell native contiguous-column algorithm is shared with the editor, retaining Unicode case folding, ambiguity/no-match empty strings, 5000 rows in each direction, no selection changes and no UI preference dependency. Macro calls share the 1,000,000 scan-work budget (10,000 reserved per call); input cap 32768 bytes.

Native checkbox format only; Type returns 0, 2 or Empty for mixed cell formats; SetCheckbox uses existing insert.checkbox, preserves values/formulas and fills empty cells with False. MAX_CELLS budget and one rectangular area. Protected sheets refuse. Exact changed-empty-cell event targets are reserved before mutation, with the existing 64-area callback bound; formatting-only repeats do not generate value-change events. Structural edits rebase handles. Existing undo and XLSX codecs persist native checkbox formatting. Type/SetCheckbox and three xlType constants come from inline sections of the existing Range.CellControl source page.

exclusions.reason: Application.InputBox explicitly requires a missing general typed/range input service. No input dialog or intrinsic is added. Office.FileDialog configuration/filter/multiselect/folder/SelectedItems/Execute graph is absent; existing native filename pickers are a narrower projection.

Range.CheckSpelling and FunctionWizard have existing interactive tools but no selected range-owned VBA completion contract; they remain explicit PLATFORM_SERVICE_NEEDED rows outside this selected profile. No fake success or new tool is supplied.

No independent ScreenUpdating/DisplayAlerts/custom StatusBar/Cursor/OnKey suppression/override/settings state, AutoCorrect or ErrorCheckingOptions configuration object, dialog-sheet runtime, arbitrary Office form-control/third-party ActiveX/OLE runtime, smart tags, research or speech provider. Existing shape OnAction/assigned-macro wiring remains covered by OM12/OM11 and shared user forms remain tiny-vba contracts. Low runtime work stays deferred.
